tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Ground: video backgrounds, title cards, thumbnails, page background. The night-view haze color in Stadium Studio; light theme is the blueprint paper.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Raised panels and cards on night-900.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on night-900 and night-800.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on night-900 and night-800.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, taglines, source lines on night-900 and night-800.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand block color: blueprint sheets, cover blocks, end cards. Put ink (dark theme) or white text on it.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: The signature glow: outlines, flowing train lines, drop arrows in the design layer. Also fact highlights on night-900.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Second flow line beside glow-cyan (alternate directions); never alone as the main accent.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The short rule under titles and venue names. Marks only, not body text.

tokens.name: granite
tokens.usage: Then-vs-now accent: anything that belongs to the past era (1910 labels, the old building). Pink granite of the 1910 Penn Station.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Dimension lines, leader lines and label text drawn over the 3D picture (always with the label-stroke shadow).

tokens.name: label-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline behind white text and lines on the 3D picture, so they read on any background.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Recording and LIVE marks only. Never decoration.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
